items.quote: We've watched our film more times than we can count. Usama caught moments we didn't even know happened — my nani laughing during the rukhsati still makes me cry.

items.quote: Calm, invisible, and completely in tune with us. The teaser was ready before the walima and every single guest asked who filmed it.

items.quote: It doesn't feel like a wedding video. It feels like a film about us. Worth every rupee and then some.

items.quote: The photographs are pure art — natural, warm, and nothing like the stiff poses we were dreading.
